title: Godot Crashes on Hot Reload with Rust gdext Extention
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.stable.arch_linux
v4.5.stable.arch_linux

same problem

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable unknown - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 18 Jan 2026 00:34:07 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics (TGL GT1) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400H @ 2.70GHz (12 threads) - 15.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

This crash occurs when I compile my Rust lib with the editor open (trying to hot reload). Using the _gdext_ extension for Rust bindings

```
   Compiling LosSementales v0.1.0 (/mnt/harddrive/Proyects/LosSementales/rust)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 1.94s

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.stable.arch_linux
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
[1] /usr/lib/libc.so.6(+0x3e4d0) [0x7fa4fae4d4d0] (??:0)
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
================================================================
[cargo-make] INFO - Build Done in 3.23 seconds.
```

### Steps to reproduce

I have a script that compiles my Rust code, and copies it to a directory where it is read by the gdext rust.

```
[tasks.debug]
script = [
    "cargo build",
    "cp target/debug/libLosSementales.so ../godot/bin/libLosSementales.so"
]
```

_.gdextension_ file:
```
[configuration]
entry_symbol = "gdext_rust_init"
compatibility_minimum = 4.1
reloadable = true

[libraries]
windows.debug.x86_64 =   "res://bin/LosSementales.dll"
windows.release.x86_64 = "res://bin/LosSementales.dll"
linux.debug.x86_64 =     "res://bin/libLosSementales.so"
linux.release.x86_64 =   "res://bin/libLosSementales.so"
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24900277/issue.zip)
